title: Amazon invests in X-energy and targets 5 GW of Xe-100 reactors by 2039

sources.quote: We have three publicly announced customers in (1) Dow, (2) Amazon, both of whom have made an equity investment in X-energy and (3) Centrica.

Amazon and Energy Northwest entered into a Carbon Free Development and Funding Agreement for an initial deployment of four reactors representing 320 MWe, with the potential to upsize the power capacity to 960 MWe.

explain: Amazon became an owner of small-reactor developer X-energy in October 2024, alongside plans for more than 5 GW of Xe-100 reactors by 2039 (first: four reactors with Energy Northwest in Washington). Amazon's exact check was not disclosed; X-energy's prospectus shows a $20M Amazon convertible note plus a warrant later worth about $285M, within a $626.5M 2024 round. Plants: planned Xe-100 units near Richland, Washington (Energy Northwest).
